text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tokyo Daishoten. Oi 
Racecourse was filled with even more 
excitement than in previous years.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seemed that the attention on Smart 
Falcon was directly translating into 
attention for dirt racing as a whole.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Smart Falcon learned that 
attendance for today was less than a third 
of what it was for the recent Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Distracted by the difference in attention, 
Smart Falcon loses focus. The Trainer 
tells her to focus solely on winning.
